name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
card_note: Go at 07:00 opening. 1200 steps. SAARC 20 USD.

name: Pidurangala Rock
card_note: Best sunrise view of Sigiriya. Last bit is a scramble.

name: Dambulla Cave Temple
card_note: Cover shoulders and knees.

name: Polonnaruwa Ancient City
card_note: Hire a bicycle. Hot by midday.

name: Anuradhapura Sacred City
card_note: Sacred area ticket. Huge site; a full day.

name: Mihintale
card_note: Birthplace of Buddhism in Sri Lanka. Steps; go early.

name: Minneriya National Park (safari)
card_note: The Gathering: hundreds of elephants Jul-Oct. All-in fee higher plus jeep.

name: Kaudulla National Park (safari)
card_note: Elephant alternative when Minneriya is quiet.

name: Ritigala Forest Monastery
card_note: Lesser-known jungle ruins. Good for reels.

name: Yapahuwa Rock Fortress
card_note: Lesser-known. Grand staircase. Usually empty.

name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
card_note: Visit at a puja time. Shoulders and knees covered.

name: Kandyan Dance Show
card_note: Evening show near the lake.

name: Ambuluwawa Tower
card_note: Narrow spiral top; not for vertigo.

name: Horton Plains & World's End
card_note: Arrive by 06:30 before cloud covers the view. All-in fee higher.

name: Tea factory visit (e.g. Pedro)
card_note: Fee not researched yet.

name: Train: Nanu Oya to Ella
card_note: Kandy side suspended since Cyclone Ditwah. Nanu Oya-Ella runs since 2026-07-18.

name: Nine Arches Bridge
card_note: Free. Check train times to see one cross.

name: Little Adam's Peak
card_note: Free. Easy sunrise hike.

name: Ella Rock
card_note: Harder hike. Some guides charge informally on the path.

name: Ravana Falls
card_note: Roadside stop; fullest after rain.

name: Lipton's Seat
card_note: Fee not researched yet. Go for sunrise.

name: Adam's Peak (Sri Pada)
card_note: Night climb for sunrise. Season Dec-May only.

name: Knuckles Range hikes
card_note: Needs a local guide. Lesser-known.

name: Galle Fort
card_note: Free to walk. Small museums inside charge 1.50-6 USD.

name: Whale watching from Mirissa
card_note: Blue whales. Seas rough outside season.

name: Mulkirigala Rock Temple
card_note: Lesser-known cave temple.

name: Yala National Park (safari)
card_note: Leopards. Plus jeep 40-55 USD half day. Usually closes part of Sep-Oct.

name: Udawalawe National Park (safari)
card_note: Most reliable elephant sightings year-round.

name: Bundala National Park
card_note: Birds. Migrants Sep-Mar.

name: Sinharaja Rainforest
card_note: UNESCO rainforest. Guide required. Leeches.

name: Negombo fish market & lagoon
card_note: Good first or last day near the airport.

name: Pigeon Island snorkelling
card_note: Park fee only. Boat + snorkel about 48 USD.

name: Arugam Bay
card_note: Surf season May-Oct.

name: Pasikudah Beach
card_note: Shallow calm bay. Good for families.

name: Kumana National Park
card_note: Birds and leopards; far fewer jeeps than Yala.

name: Nallur Kandaswamy Temple
card_note: Men remove shirts to enter.

name: Wilpattu National Park
card_note: Quieter leopard park than Yala.
